info.title: docconv: convert documents between formats, in memory, for humans and agents.
info.description: docconv: command line document conversion for humans and agents. Built on the DocConverter library.

options.name: --input
options.description:
Input file, or - for stdin (required)
Input to examine

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file, or - for stdout (required)

options.name: --from
options.description:
Source format. Omitted: detected from content, using the
input file extension as a hint

options.name: --to
options.description:
Target format. Omitted: taken from the output extension.
Required when -o is -

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Replace an existing output file

options.name: --options
options.description: Load conversion options from a JSON file; flags override it

options.name: --title
options.description: Title written into targets that carry one

options.name: --no-images
options.description: Drop all images

options.name: --images
options.description:
embed, omit, placeholder or external (Markdown and HTML).
Default: placeholder for Markdown, embed for HTML.
external writes image files next to the output file

options.name: --no-metadata
options.description: Do not carry title, author and other metadata

options.name: --input-encoding
options.description: Encoding of text input (default: byte order mark, then utf-8)

options.name: --output-encoding
options.description: Encoding of text output (default: utf-8 without BOM)

options.name: --deterministic
options.description: Pin timestamps and ids so identical input gives identical bytes

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings as errors: exit 5 and remove the output file

options.name: --csv-delimiter
options.description: CSV or TSV delimiter, a single character or 'tab'

options.name: --no-header
options.description: CSV or TSV input has no header row

options.name: --table
options.description: Which tables to write to CSV or TSV

options.name: --html-fragment
options.description: Write body content only, without html, head and body

options.name: --html-no-css
options.description: Omit the embedded stylesheet

options.name: --text-wrap
options.description: Wrap plain text at n columns (0, or 20 to 1000)

options.name: --json-compact
options.description: Write JSON without indentation

options.name: --json-no-binary
options.description: Leave image bytes out of JSON

options.name: --page-size
options.description: PDF and DOCX page size

options.name: --margin
options.description: PDF and DOCX page margin in points (0 to 216)

options.name: --slide-split
options.description: PPTX: start a new slide at headings of this level or lower

options.name: --include-notes
options.description: PPTX input: include speaker notes

options.name: --include-hidden-sheets
options.description: XLSX input: include hidden sheets

options.name: --preserve-pages
options.description: PDF input: keep each page as its own section

options.name: --max-input-mb
options.description:
Largest accepted input in megabytes (default 256)
Largest accepted input in megabytes

options.name: --json
options.description: Write a one line JSON report (see REPORTS)

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress the summary line (errors still go to stderr)
